items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Johnny Griffin in the context of Lockjaw Barnes ('Lockjaws'), but the interviewee (Cozy Cole) does not respond or provide any information about a personal or professional relationship with Johnny Griffin.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, yeah. Don and Hawk. It was a good combination, both of them. The same way with Lockjaws and Jimmy.
Johnny Griffin. They worked in the Metropole as a duo together for weeks, yeah, Johnny Griffin and Lockjaws.
